discovery.summary: Request a reserve amount change for a claim you are assigned to adjust.
discovery.title: Adjust claim reserve

review.when: The selected assigned claim and its current portfolio are active, the requested reserve is within the private claim ceiling and portfolio cap, there is no active freeze, and the complete current claim and freeze collections remain within their reviewed bounds.
review.then: Propose changing only the selected claim's reserve to the requested cents. It can complete only after approval, separate execution enablement, and a running supervised worker rechecks current facts.
refused: Refuse when any current status, private ceiling, freeze, collection, budget, identity, or concurrency check fails or cannot be proven.
review.human_review: A valid request not automatically approved, including one above the routine ceiling or over an automatic-approval limit, requires one insurance supervisor. Invalid requests are refused.

examples.scenario: An active assigned claim has a requested reserve within all private ceilings and cap, no active freeze, and the automatic criteria and limits allow approval.
examples.result: The reserve-change proposal is automatically approved; completion still requires separately enabled supervised execution.

examples.scenario: All validity checks pass, but the requested reserve is above the routine automatic-approval ceiling or an automatic approval limit is reached.
examples.result: The valid proposal requires one insurance supervisor and does not bypass any check.

examples.scenario: The claim or portfolio is closed, an active freeze exists, a collection is incomplete or over 64 rows, or the adjusted total would exceed the cap.
examples.result: The request is refused without disclosing private facts.

action_skeletons.intent: Draft one rule-derived outcome: adjust a caller-selected opaque claim reference's reserve_cents to bounded desired_cents (1000–100000), advancing its version, only for the Runner-injected trusted insurer/adjuster. Require the selected claim and exact current portfolio active; desired_cents within the private per-claim ceiling; complete current scoped freeze collection (stable PK order, <=64) with zero active freezes; complete current scoped claim collection (stable PK order, <=64), selected active claim exactly once, and active-claim reserve sum minus current selected reserve plus desired_cents within the private portfolio reserve cap. Protect current parent, selected row, and collections through the source transaction and reject stale/concurrent evidence. Automatically approve only when all checks pass, desired_cents is within the current private routine ceiling, and Runner proposal-ledger limits for this outcome allow at most 8 approvals overall and 3 per trusted insurer in rolling 24 hours. Other valid requests require exactly one insurance_supervisor; invalid requests refuse. Human approval bypasses no hard checks. After approval, separately reviewed supervised worker completion reruns current checks before applying the update; routing/drafting remains disabled pending later activation.
